b: Hey Mr Gurney, my name is Blaise Pakaluk, and I’ve been following your YouTube for about two years now. The cliché thing is to say that you have no bigger fan, but it may be true.😂
I’m in AP art and your work has inspired many of my own pieces. I am unceasingly amazed by your ability to paint your cool ideas with astounding realism.

I’m a bit of a nerd, and one of my chief goals in art is to put my imagination on canvas, and you’ve helped a lot with that. I can’t wait to get your “Color and Light” and “Imaginative realism” for my birthday.

Here is a link to photos of three paintings I have done which I hope you will enjoy. One of which was a study on your work, so I hope you recognize it. The next is a plein air that I did inspired by your love of painting “in the wild”. And the last is a painting I made up, albeit with a combination of reference objects, in an attempt to paint my imagination. It is about a soldier forced to fight for an evil regime despite his hatred of it. I would love your comments on all three, but mostly I just wanted to show you them.

A last thing is that I would really like to meet you sometime or someday. I am unfamiliar with where you live (New York?) but I live in Maryland, and it would be awesome to have a chance learn from you in person.
P.S. Somehow there is a photo of me in the drive. I’m not sure how that got there, but whatever. That is me on Mount Washington.
